violation_type.title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training -skill based and hands on (26 TAC §747.1313(b))
violation_type.short_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training -skill based and hands on
violation_type.typical_finding: CPR training for the director was completed online.

finding_variants.text: CPR training for the director was completed online.
During the inspection it was observed that the primary caregiver and two caregivers did not have a valid CPR certification.
The CPR and first aid training has expired.
Three staff did not have current Pediatric cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) training.
The primary caregiver does not have CPR training that adheres to the guidelines as a manikin was not used and hands on training was not completed.
The primary caregiver and assistant caregiver both have online only CPR certificates.
